name: List
purpose: Render finished ordered or unordered content with native list semantics, optional structured rows, markers, density, and boundaries.
useWhen: Content is naturally a set of peer items or a sequence and needs Brick's finished list presentation.

avoidWhen.condition: Rows are persistent route destinations or need current-route state.
Rows form a keyboard-operated choice, action collection, data table, or two-dimensional grid.
avoidWhen.useInstead: Listbox, Menu, Table, or DataGrid according to the interaction

avoidWhen.condition: Content only needs visual spacing and has no list relationship.

composition: For simple typography use density=none and inset=none with gap. Use size=inherit to inherit a surrounding Text div's complete font recipe; md remains the default. Do not merge Text and List.Root on one host because both own data-variant.

Set markerTone on Root or Item for native marker color, and nestedInset on the nested Root for responsive indentation. Use Icon tone and size for authored glyphs; Leading aligns them with the first line.
All five presentation parts support asChild with one element. Keep normal Item for structured rows. List does not expose an Indicator alias or Chakra's generic style-prop engine.
Compose Root > Item; for structured rows use Leading, Content with Title and Description, then Trailing in that order.
Use ordered only when sequence changes meaning and preserve native list hosts when composing with asChild or render.
Keep Trailing for compact metadata or controls; when a long action would narrow supporting copy, place the action with the title inside Content using Brick layout instead.

Use Root align="center" when a compact leading visual and one-line content should share a visual center; keep the default start for multi-line rows whose leading and trailing parts belong with the first line.
Use Root inset="none" when an ordinary List's leading content must share a logical start with adjacent sibling content; keep the default inset for standalone List rhythm.
Record selection uses the public selection utility; optional ActionDelegate points to a visible descendant link, button or checkbox. The host owns no keyboard navigation.

Use Root gap for responsive peer spacing, density=none for zero block inset, and inset=none for zero inline inset. asChild li retains typography; use normal Item for structured Leading/Content/Trailing.

rules.statement: Use the shared token-only radius contract only on the public parts listed in docs/guides/radius.md. Omit it to retain the owner default; do not combine it with legacy corner shape or forward it to native elements. Core names and semantic roles are distinct; popup boundaries are independent of their triggers.
Use List only for a real item or sequence relationship and preserve native list semantics.
Keep structured row parts in Leading, Content, Trailing order and use one Content and one Trailing maximum per Item.
Keep Trailing compact; move long actions into a Content-owned layout when a fixed trailing column would damage narrow-screen reading.
List retains native semantics and adds no focus movement. Use the public selection utility and ActionDelegate with real controls for record interactions, not custom List event emulation.
Load styles.css or core.css plus list.css.
Use the closed Root align recipe before overriding --brick-list-part-align or adding consumer CSS for structured row alignment.
Use the closed Root inset recipe before overriding --brick-list-row-padding-inline or adding consumer CSS for ordinary row inset.

Use selected only as presentation alongside a named Checkbox. Compose useSelection and ActionDelegate for record selection and primary activation; retain native semantics, actual controls and independent secondary actions. Never add row role=button or a tab stop. See docs/guides/record-selection.md.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using List as a generic row layout, making an Item itself clickable, or placing a long action in Trailing until supporting text becomes a narrow column.
commonMistakes.correction: Use Stack or Grid for non-list layout, NavList for route destinations, or ActionDelegate with a real descendant control for record activation. Move long actions into Content's own layout.

commonMistakes.mistake: Assuming an Item's disabled presentation disables controls inside it.
commonMistakes.correction: Apply the proper disabled contract to every interactive descendant; List's disabled state is descriptive and visual only.

commonMistakes.mistake: Overriding item padding merely to align a feature list with a sibling heading.
commonMistakes.correction: Use Root inset="none" for the flush relationship.

validation: Inspect ul or ol and li output, ordered meaning, marker behavior, structured-part order, nesting, roles, and CSS delivery.

Test long titles and descriptions, compact and comfortable density, both inset recipes, all variants, markers, and structured alignments, first-line marker alignment in bordered simple and structured rows, 320 CSS px, 200 and 400 percent zoom, RTL, and forced colors.
Confirm Trailing content does not squeeze Content, controls have names and touch targets, disabled descendants are handled explicitly, and List adds no keyboard model.
